name: Lina's starfighter
description: A starfighter was used by the E'roni pilot Lina during the war between her homeworld E'ronoh and the planet Eiram. Between 387 BBY and 382 BBY, Lina intended to undertake a mission to Eiram's western isles, though her fighter's thruster malfunctioned moments after she took off and she crashed into Ramshead Gorge.
